In 1025 , with the death of his eldest brother Hugh Magnus , he and Henry rebelled against their father and defeated him , forcing him back to Paris . Peace was only achieved when Robert was given Burgundy ( 1032 ) . Throughout his reign , he was little more than a robber baron who had no control over his vassals , whose estates he often plundered , especially those of the Church . He seized the income of the diocese of Autun and the wine of the canons of Dijon . He burgled the abbey of St-Germain at Auxerre .
